hotels.title: Maldives Overwater Villas with Seaplane Transfers, Daily Breakfast + Daily Lunch & Dinner with Free-Flow Drinks
hotels.description: It’s the iconic OUTRIGGER barefoot luxury you love in the world’s most spectacular destination: surrounded by lush gardens, warm sands and the brilliant-blue South Ari Atoll. When you’re not relaxing on your sun-washed overwater villa, drift into bliss at the ocean-perched Navasana Spa, sample lobster and grilled sirloin at Moodhu Grill or savour teppanyaki thrills at Koto. The resort’s PADI dive centre and house reef - brimming with manta rays, shimmering schools of marine life and the occasional whale shark - offer some of the best underwater experiences in the archipelago. Return from underwater adventures to artisanal, island-made ice cream and superb coffee at Kofee ‘n Chill or breezy poolside cocktails and light bites at Edgewater. Even little adventurers are treated to the good life, with one child (11 and under) staying and eating free, making this stay a delight for all ages (excludes Two Bedroom Villa with Private Pool). Enjoy a complimentary sunset cruise to witness the tapestry of colours as the sun dips below the horizon. After, you may choose to take the luxury up a notch with moonlit modern fine dining at the exquisite Art-I-San, magically set at the highest point on the island, or a personalised dining experience on the golden-hued shore.
